The Framingham approach

More room to explore.

Build your visit around what appeals to you: warmth, water, stillness, or a dedicated therapy appointment. There is no prescribed sequence. Our team can help you choose a starting point, and you can move at your own pace.

Available in Framingham

Explore the experiences.

Both locations

Infrared sauna

Gentle infrared warmth for a slower moment in your day.

Benefits & considerations

Warmth & unwinding. A favorite for slowing down, easing into stillness, and enjoying a deep sense of warmth. Some people notice they feel looser and more relaxed afterward.

Make it your moment. Settle in at a comfortable pace and give yourself time to cool down between experiences.

Both locations

Cold plunge

A cool-water immersion experience, on its own or alongside warmth.

Benefits & considerations

Refresh & reset. People love the invigorating contrast of cool water after warmth, and the refreshed feeling that follows. It may also help ease the feeling of muscle soreness after a demanding workout.

Make it your moment. Make it a brief, comfortable part of your visit. There is no need to compete on time or temperature.

Both locations

Normatec compression

Rhythmic air compression around your legs while you recline.

Benefits & considerations

Rest for hardworking legs. The rhythmic squeeze-and-release feels like a hands-free leg massage. A popular choice after a workout or a long day on your feet, it may help legs feel less sore and more rested.

Make it your moment. Recline, relax, and let the session become a little downtime. In Framingham, pair it with guided meditation.

Framingham

BrainTap meditation

Guided audio and a light-and-sound headset for a focused pause.

Benefits & considerations

Quiet the mental chatter. An immersive combination of guided audio and light creates space to pause and turn your attention inward. People choose it to wind down, practice focus, or transition out of a busy day.

Make it your moment. Pick a program that matches your mood, settle into the chair, and let yourself take a break from your screen.

Framingham

Salt chamber

A quiet salt-lined setting for time away from the everyday.

Benefits & considerations

Stillness & atmosphere. The salt-lined setting is a favorite for a peaceful pause. Enjoy the distinctive atmosphere, sit quietly, and make room for a few unhurried moments.

Make it your moment. Let the environment be the experience: no sequence to follow and no task to complete.

Framingham

Eucalyptus steam room

Moist warmth with eucalyptus, as part of your Framingham visit.

Benefits & considerations

A warm, sensory escape. Moist heat and eucalyptus create a cocoon-like atmosphere. Guests enjoy the soothing warmth and the sensory change from the rest of the spa.

Make it your moment. Enjoy it as a moment of stillness or as one part of your own warm-and-cool routine.

Framingham

Warm-water hydrotherapy

Settle into the warm water of our Framingham hot tub.

Benefits & considerations

Soak & soften your pace. Warm water and buoyancy help create a feeling of lightness and support. People love settling into the hot tub to unwind and enjoy an easy, comforting soak.

Make it your moment. Take your time getting comfortable and let the warm water be a change of pace between experiences.

Framingham

BioCharger

A seated light-and-frequency experience in a dedicated space.

Benefits & considerations

A different kind of pause. For guests curious about biohacking and holistic wellness, BioCharger offers a distinctive light-and-frequency experience. People enjoy exploring its programs and taking a quiet, seated break.

Make it your moment. Come curious. Choose a program with our team and notice how the experience feels for you.

Framingham · Premium

PEMF therapy

A separate appointment using pulsed electromagnetic field equipment.

Benefits & considerations

Comfort & a focused recovery ritual. People explore pulsed electromagnetic field sessions as part of a routine focused on everyday comfort and mobility. It offers dedicated time to rest while the equipment delivers its programmed pulses.

Make it your moment. Make space for a separate appointment, or add a session to your Framingham day pass.

Framingham · Premium

Flowpresso

Full-body compression, gentle warmth, and deep pressure in a dedicated appointment.

Benefits & considerations

Feel held. Wind down.. Gentle warmth, full-body compression, and deep pressure create an enveloping experience. People choose it for a comforting pause and the chance to switch out of go-go-go mode.

Make it your moment. Set aside time for this dedicated appointment and let the quiet be part of your visit.

Choose what feels right for you. Experiences and results vary. If you are pregnant, have a heart or circulation condition, an implanted electronic device, or sensitivity to heat, cold, or flashing light, check with your healthcare professional before visiting and let us know. Our team can review the relevant studio guidance with you. Medical disclaimer (PDF) ↗
